dz: 印尼安汶岛发生地震. 它引发了100米(330英尺)特大海啸,淹死了2300多人.

te: England and the Netherlands sign the Treaty of Westminster, ending the Third Anglo-Dutch War. A provision of the agreem…
dz: 英格兰和荷兰签署"威斯敏斯特条约",结束了第三次盎格鲁-荷兰战争. 协议的一条规定将荷兰殖民地新阿姆斯特丹转移到了英国.
de: England and the Netherlands sign the Treaty of Westminster, ending the Third Anglo-Dutch War. A provision of the agreement transfers the Dutch colony of New Amsterdam to England.

te: The Battle of Ronas Voe results in the Dutch East India Company ship Wapen van Rotterdam being captured with a death to…
dz: 第三次盎格鲁-荷兰战争:罗纳斯·沃伊之战导致荷属东印度公司船只瓦彭·范·鹿特丹被俘,多达300名荷兰船员和士兵被俘.
de: The Third Anglo-Dutch War: The Battle of Ronas Voe results in the Dutch East India Company ship Wapen van Rotterdam being captured with a death toll of up to 300 Dutch crew and soldiers.

te: As provided in the Treaty of Westminster, Netherlands cedes New Netherland to England.
dz: 第三次盎格鲁-荷兰战争:按照"荷兰威斯敏斯特条约"的规定,将新尼德兰割让给英国.
de: Third Anglo-Dutch War: As provided in the Treaty of Westminster, Netherlands cedes New Netherland to England.
